name: uneven_pacing
description: Three quick setup actions at the very start of the video followed by one slow closing action at the very end. The frame-bunching bug shows up here because the synthesis model is tempted to anchor the closing steps to the last frame.
transcript: I quickly grab the screwdriver, then the wrench, then the cloth from the bench. After that I spend several minutes carefully wiping down the assembled motor housing before placing it on the rack.

frame_observations.description: Hand reaching for the phillips screwdriver on the workbench.
Operator picking up the wrench from the bench.
Operator picking up the cloth from the bench corner.
Wiping the front of the motor housing with the cloth.
Wiping the side of the motor housing, cloth visibly soiled.
Wiping the back of the motor housing, almost finished.
Final inspection of the wiped motor housing, cloth set aside.
Clean motor housing being placed on the rack.
